title: Word Meanings
description: Use sentence context, word parts, categories, and shades of meaning to work out and explain what words mean.
learningFocus: Use sentence-level context as a clue to the meaning of a word or phrase (L.1.4(a)).
Use frequently occurring affixes as clues to word meaning (L.1.4(b)).
Sort and define words by category and key attributes (L.1.5(a), L.1.5(b)).
Connect words to real life and distinguish shades of meaning among related verbs and adjectives (L.1.5(c), L.1.5(d)).
adultGuidance: Words can have shades of meaning. Help your child use the words around a hard word to work out what it means. Talk about how un- and -ful change a word. Ask which word is stronger: big, huge, or gigantic? Help your child name groups, tell what they share, and use a word from their own day.
